Class ElectricBike

java.lang.Object
ElectricBike
public class ElectricBike extends Object
Model the common elements of an Electric bike (EB) that operates within the simulation, moving towards a target and potentially recharging. * @author David J. Barnes and Michael Kölling

    • ElectricBike

      public ElectricBike(EBCompany company, Location location, Location targetLocation, String id, int batteryCapacity)
      Constructor of class ElectricBike.
      Parameters:
      company - The EB's operating company. Must not be null.
      location - The EB's starting Location. Must not be null.
      targetLocation - The EB's final destination Location. Must not be null.
      id - The identificator of the bike.
      batteryCapacity - The maximum capacity of the battery.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If company, location, or targetLocation is null.

    • calculateRoute

      public void calculateRoute()
      Calculates the optimal route for the bike. If there isn't enough battery to reach the target, it attempts to find an intermediate BikeStation and sets it as the rechargingLocation.

    • getStringRoute

      public String getStringRoute()
      Gets a string representation of the planned route, including the recharging stop if one exists.
      Returns:
      A string showing the route: currentLocation -> [rechargingLocation ->] targetLocation.

      public void calculateRechargingPosition()
